name: Proximal Jointly-Optimized Reconstruction and Denoising
definition: A GPU-accelerated iterative tomographic reconstruction approach that integrates denoising into the reconstruction process by alternating between minimizing re-projection error using algebraic reconstruction techniques and decreasing noise using various regularization and denoising methods.
summary: Proximal Jointly-Optimized Reconstruction and Denoising is a GPU-accelerated iterative tomographic method that simultaneously reconstructs and denoises volumes, maintaining direct consistency with raw input projections unlike traditional separate-step pipelines.
